nominalPlain.label: Nominal 4,000 ft Abeam -> Plain TRJ
nominalPlain.planNote: Line abreast right to Echelon right: hot turning rejoin. Lead turns into #2 at 30° of bank, slowing to 200 KIAS (SMM 16.20 para 65b). #2 cuts across onto the rejoin line, and from 1200 ft in he puts Lead on the X, fin and far wing crossed at his 10:30, slightly low, and holds him fixed on the canopy (SMM 12.24 paras 56-57, Fig 12.15). He gets colder with geometry, not power: his slowest is 194 KIAS, and he is at 198 KIAS on the line (TS-75). At 250 ft, at Lead's speed with Lead on the X, he moves over and slides up the line into echelon (Patrick 03:32Z-03:44Z: anywhere 250-100 ft from Lead, 10-20 KIAS over him). Chosen: turning rejoin 39 s, over tracker 113 s (the fallback on a long move).

nominalRoll.label: Nominal 4,000 ft Abeam -> Rolling Rejoin
nominalRoll.planNote: Line abreast right to Echelon right: turning rejoin with a barrel roll. Lead turns into #2 at 30° of bank and holds it until #2 is in (SMM 16.20 para 65b). #2 flies a barrel roll, rolling away from Lead's turn at full power, 4 G, nose 40° up and down, heading swung 30° the way Lead turns, for 16 s; slowest 167 KIAS, closest to Lead 1,761 ft. Then the turning rejoin from where he rolls out (SMM 12.24 paras 56-58). The SMM has no rolling rejoin (nearest: SMM 14.8 paras 18-19, the barrel roll); the numbers are estimates.

hotPlain.label: Hot/Acute Start (+20 kt, +1200 ft ahead) -> Plain TRJ
hotPlain.planNote: In trail to Echelon right: straight-ahead rejoin. Chosen: tracker 120 s (the fallback on a long move), over from here 64 s (fails a check) (the fallback on a long move).

hotRoll.label: Hot/Acute Start (+20 kt, +1200 ft ahead) -> Rolling Rejoin
hotRoll.planNote: From here to Echelon right: turning rejoin with a barrel roll. Lead turns into #2 at 30° of bank and holds it until #2 is in (SMM 16.20 para 65b). #2 flies a barrel roll, rolling away from Lead's turn at full power, 4 G, nose 60° up and down, heading swung 30° the way Lead turns, for 18 s; slowest 159 KIAS, closest to Lead 654 ft. Then the turning rejoin from where he rolls out (SMM 12.24 paras 56-58). The SMM has no rolling rejoin (nearest: SMM 14.8 paras 18-19, the barrel roll); the numbers are estimates.
